default.heading: Premier Accounting & Tax Consultancy
default.paragraph_1: H&S Auditors is a premier Accounting & Tax consultancy firm. Our team of seasoned specialists brings together deep expertise in GST, Income Tax, Bookkeeping, Audit & Assurance and Business Registration.
default.paragraph_2: We believe every business deserves financial clarity without compromise. Our commitment to integrity, confidentiality, and timely delivery has made us the preferred partner for businesses across India.

00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000005.title: Audit & Assurance
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000005.short_description: Statutory, internal and tax audits that ensure compliance and transparency.
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000005.long_description: Independent audits provide lenders, shareholders, and regulatory authorities with absolute confidence in your financial statements. We conduct statutory audits under the Companies Act, tax audits under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act, internal audits to strengthen internal controls, and inventory/stock verifications.
benefits: Rigorous verification adhering to ICAI Standards
Internal audits designed to mitigate financial risks
Enhanced credibility with investors and banking institutions
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000005.seo_description: Statutory, internal and tax audits that ensure complete compliance and financial transparency.

sub_services.title: Statutory Audit
sub_services.description: Audit under the Companies Act 2013 with compliance to applicable standards (SA/AS).

sub_services.title: Tax Audit (Sec. 44AB)
sub_services.description: Audit for businesses exceeding prescribed turnover with reporting in Form 3CA/3CB and 3CD.

sub_services.title: Internal Audit
sub_services.description: Risk-based internal audit processes to strengthen controls and governance.

sub_services.title: GST Audit & Reconciliation
sub_services.description: Annual reconciliation of books with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2A and certified reconciliation in GSTR-9C.

00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000001.title: GST Filing
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000001.short_description: Accurate, hassle-free GST registration, monthly returns and reconciliation.
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000001.long_description: Navigating Goods and Services Tax in India requires meticulous attention to deadlines, classification, and input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation. H&S Auditors provides comprehensive GST advisory, registration, periodic return filings (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C), departmental audit support, and handling of departmental notices to ensure 100% statutory compliance without business disruption.
benefits: Prompt monthly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings
Expert handling of GST departmental notices & audits
Assistance in GST refund applications for exporters
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000001.seo_title: GST Filing & Compliance Services | H&S Auditors
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000001.seo_description: Accurate, hassle-free GST registration, monthly returns and reconciliation by experienced tax professionals.

sub_services.title: GST Registration
sub_services.description: Registration once turnover crosses ₹40 lakh for goods or ₹20 lakh for services (₹20 lakh / ₹10 lakh in special category states), plus voluntary and composition registrations.

sub_services.title: Return Filing
sub_services.description: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, CMP-08, GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C filed on time, with input tax credit matched against GSTR-2B every month.

sub_services.title: Refunds & Exports
sub_services.description: Refund claims for exports, LUT filing, SEZ supplies and inverted duty structure under Section 54.

sub_services.title: Notices & Assessment
sub_services.description: Replies to ASMT-10, DRC-01 and audit notices, plus representation before GST officers and appellate authorities.

00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000002.title: Income Tax
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000002.short_description: Maximise tax savings while staying fully compliant with the Income Tax Act.
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000002.long_description: Our direct tax consultancy assists corporate entities, partnerships, LLPs, and individuals in strategic tax planning, advance tax computation, tax-deducted-at-source (TDS) management, and annual return filings. We provide sound representation in scrutiny assessments and appeals before tax authorities, keeping your tax liability optimised and fully legitimate.
benefits: Proactive tax planning under new & old regimes
Advance tax computation to avoid interest penalties
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000002.seo_title: Income Tax Planning & Filing Services | H&S Auditors
00000000-0000-0000-0004-000000000002.seo_description: Maximise tax savings while staying fully compliant with the Income Tax Act with expert advisory from H&S Auditors.

sub_services.title: Return Filing
sub_services.description: ITR-1 to ITR-7 filed with the right regime choice — old vs. new — and complete capital gains, house property and foreign asset disclosure.

sub_services.title: TDS & TCS
sub_services.description: Monthly deduction and deposit, quarterly 24Q/26Q/27Q returns, Form 16/16A issuance and correction of defaults on TRACES.

sub_services.title: Advance Tax & Planning
sub_services.description: Quarterly advance tax computation (15 June, 15 Sept, 15 Dec, 15 March) and lawful tax planning under Chapter VI-A and presumptive schemes 44AD/44ADA.

sub_services.title: Assessments & Appeals
sub_services.description: Responses to Section 143(1), 143(2), 148 and faceless assessment notices, and appeals before CIT(A) and ITAT.
